correctness.rationale: The published exact rates specialize to the two opposing single-zealot chain. Reversible unnormalized masses binom(S,k)^(1-q) satisfy detailed balance. The backward equations give the exact finite-sum first-hitting mean. Uniform prefix bound 1+O(1/S) and Gaussian localization with exponentially small tails yield C_q S^(-(q-2)/2)2^((q-1)S). The embedded checker verified 260 finite exact-rational generator and moment identities and asymptotic diagnostics. The proof, not finite tests, establishes the infinite limit. Fixed q, selected-voter time units and nonabsorbing endpoints are explicit.

value.rationale: A fixed number of committed agents is a natural weak-zealotry scaling missed by a fixed-positive-density continuum approximation. The exact mean switching time has an exponential rate 2^((q-1)S), a q-sensitive polynomial factor, and an explicit constant; the finite exact expression is a reproducible benchmark. This resolves a meaningful first-passage timescale gap rather than merely recomputing a known stationary distribution. The result does not purport to predict real elections.
